questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答(1)由于}\frac{\sin^{2}n}{2^{n}}<(\frac{1}{2})^{n},\text{而}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}(\frac{1}{2})^{n}\text{收敛,由比较审敛法知级数}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{\sin^{2}n}{2^{n}}\text{收敛}.\\&(2)\text{由于}u_{n}=\frac{1+(2n-1)}{1+(2n-1)^{2}},\lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}\frac{u_{n}}{n}=\lim_{n\rightarrow\infty}\frac{n^{2}}{2n^{2}-2n+1}=\frac{1}{2},\text{调和级数}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{1}{n}\text{是发散的,由}\\&\text{比较审敛法的极限形式知级数}\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{1+(2n-1)}{1+(2n-1)^{2}}\text{发散}.\end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}&\text{解答(1)当}0\leq x\leq \frac{\pi}{n}\text{时，}\sin x\leq x\leq \frac{\pi}{n},\text{有}0\leq \int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{n}}\frac{\sin x}{1+x}dx\leq \frac{\pi}{n}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{n}}\frac{1}{1+x}dx=\frac{\pi}{n}\ln(1+\frac{\pi}{n}).\\&\text{因为}\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty}\frac{\frac{\pi}{n}-\ln(1+\frac{\pi}{n})}{n}=\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty}n\pi\cdot\frac{\pi}{n}=\pi^{2},\text{且级数}\sum_{p=1}^{\infty}\frac{1}{n^{2}}(p=2>1)\text{收敛，由比较审敛法的极限形式知级数}\sum_{p=1}^{\infty}\frac{\pi}{n}\ln(1+\frac{\pi}{n})\text{收敛，再由比较审敛法知级数}\sum_{p=1}^{\infty}\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{n}}\frac{\sin x}{1+x}dx\text{收敛.}\\&(2)\text{因为}\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty}\frac{\frac{n}{n^{2}+\ln n}}{\frac{1}{n}}=\lim_{n\rightarrow \infty}\frac{1}{1+\frac{\ln n}{n^{2}}}=1,\text{且级数}\sum_{p=1}^{\infty}\frac{1}{n}\text{发散，由比较审敛法的极限形式知}\sum_{p=1}^{\infty}\frac{n}{n^{2}+\ln n}\text{发散.}\end{aligned}
